explainer_content.short_definition: A raw 1960s singles road of local teen bands, fuzz riffs, cheap organs, shouted hooks, and proto-punk attitude.
explainer_content.history_capsule: After the British Invasion, countless local groups made fast, rough records for regional labels. The Kingsmen, The Sonics, The Seeds, Count Five, ? and the Mysterians, and The Standells show a world where crude energy often matters more than refinement. Nuggets later gave that world a durable map.
explainer_content.why_it_mattered: It preserved amateur force as a virtue. Punk, garage revival, indie rock, and psych revival repeatedly return to these singles as proof that urgency can beat skill display.
explainer_content.what_made_it_distinct: The lane is song-first and texture-first: fuzz guitar, Farfisa organ, stomp rhythm, nasal vocals, and riffs simple enough to become slogans.
what_to_listen_for: Fuzz guitar or cheap organ as lead character
A two- or three-chord riff that barely changes
Short songs that end before they develop
